services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The renting of the Community Room helps support the operations and special events of the Sherman Museum. The room is available for rental at the discretion of the Executive Director of the Museum. A partial kitchen, chairs and folding tables are available. Donations are always appreciated. The Community Room can be rented from 9:00am-9:00pm with the approval of the Executive Director. The charge for renting the Community Room is $50.00/hour with a three (3) hour minimum (minimum rental cost = $150.00). blurb: The Sherman Museum is a non-profit educational institution that acquires, preserves, interprets and displays items of enduring cultural, historical and educational value related to Grayson County and the local Red River area. Formerly known as the Red River Historical Museum, The Sherman Museum embraces our responsibility to engage and educate our community.
